Moral outrage is the only factor driving progress in overcrowded detention centers and prolonged court proceedings, which can be especially insidious by stripping minors of their liberty without access to court-appointed counsel. Indeed, after Trump issued the “zero-tolerance” policy with Mexico, losing guardianship of one’s child was considered “collateral damage of the policy.” The Trump administration shows no shame and is ready to manipulate matters involving children for political gain, yet the public cannot be silenced.
